lines.text: Greed Machine is a memecoin with mechanics: buy, hold, and participate in an autonomous treasury business.
Launch proceeds and project trading fees would fund the treasury. Retained earnings help the business keep growing.
An AI swarm scouts opportunities, proposes strategies, and debates them. Agents challenge assumptions before choosing a candidate.
Independent security reviews the candidate. Hard rules cap spending, protect reserves, and can reject every proposal.
Only approved strategies receive capital. The machine would monitor positions, manage exits, and reconcile costs and losses.
Target: sixty percent to seventy percent of eligible net profit, shared with holders in stablecoins. The rest grows the treasury.
Buy. Hold. Inspect. A memecoin designed to do business.
